summary: 本轮增量检索发现 2 项自上次成功运行后首次公开且足够相关的新工作。`Aero Hand Open` 是面向灵巧手研究的开源平台发布，直接服务于多指灵巧操作实验与复现；`RoboTok` 则把互联网规模的人类手轨迹检索和参考视频提示结合起来，为灵巧操作策略学习提供可扩展的数据引擎。两项都把灵巧手或灵巧操作放在主线位置，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This incremental pass found 2 newly public items that were relevant enough since the last successful run. `Aero Hand Open` is an open platform release for dexterous-hand research, directly supporting multi-finger manipulation experiments and reproduction; `RoboTok` combines internet-scale human hand-trajectory retrieval with reference-video prompting as a scalable data engine for dexterous policy learning. Both place dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation at the center, so they are included in this update.

items.title: Aero Hand Open
items.relevance: 这是一个直接面向灵巧手研究的开源平台发布，核心围绕多指灵巧手的机械设计、控制和实验复现展开，不是泛化的抓取或通用操控工具。
items.relevance_en: This is an open platform release aimed directly at dexterous-hand research, centered on multi-finger hand design, control, and experimental reproducibility rather than generic grasping or broad manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 这是本轮首次看到的公开平台发布，带有项目页面和代码/文档型信号，属于比单纯论文摘要更强的可复现性新增信息。
items.novelty_signal_en: This is the first public platform release seen in this run, with project-page and code/documentation signals that make it a stronger novelty update than a paper abstract alone.
items.analysis_zh: Aero Hand Open 的主要工作是公开一套面向灵巧手研究的可复用平台，解决的是多指灵巧手在控制、集成和复现实验上长期缺少统一开源基座的问题。其方法重点不在单一算法，而在把硬件平台、软件接口、控制流程和实验材料打包成可直接使用的研究入口，便于后续在真实手上做灵巧操作、手内操作和学习控制。公开信息显示它强调工程可用性和研究复现，适合承接后续数据采集与算法验证。实验层面，当前公开材料更偏平台展示与系统验证，缺少足够完整的跨任务定量比较，因此对性能上限和泛化能力的结论仍有限。总体上，这是一项偏基础设施的贡献，价值在于降低灵巧手研究门槛，但其限制是公开摘要里尚未给出足够细的基准、失败案例和长期稳定性数据。
items.analysis_en: Aero Hand Open mainly contributes an open, reusable platform for dexterous-hand research, addressing the long-standing lack of a unified open-source base for multi-finger hand control, integration, and reproducible experiments. The method is not a single algorithm; instead, it packages hardware, software interfaces, control workflows, and experimental materials into a ready-to-use research entry point for real-hand dexterous manipulation, in-hand manipulation, and learning-based control. The public information emphasizes engineering usability and reproducibility, which makes it a practical foundation for future data collection and algorithm validation. On the experimental side, the available material appears to focus more on platform demonstration and system validation than on a complete cross-task quantitative comparison, so conclusions about performance ceilings and generalization remain limited. Overall, this is an infrastructure contribution whose value lies in lowering the barrier to dexterous-hand research, but the public release still lacks detailed benchmarks, failure analysis, and long-term stability data.

items.title: RoboTok: Internet-scale retrieval engine for human hand trajectories with video prompting to advance dexterous robot manipulation
items.relevance: 它直接服务于灵巧机器人操作学习，核心是把人类手轨迹检索和视频提示转化为可扩展的数据引擎，而不是一般的人手姿态识别或泛化操作任务。
items.relevance_en: It directly serves dexterous robot manipulation learning, with a core focus on turning human hand-trajectory retrieval and video prompting into a scalable data engine rather than generic hand-pose recognition or broad manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: 这是本轮新出现的论文条目，强调互联网规模检索与视频提示，对灵巧操作数据获取方式有明确新增信息。
items.novelty_signal_en: This is a newly surfaced paper entry in this run, emphasizing internet-scale retrieval and video prompting as a clear new data-acquisition signal for dexterous manipulation.
items.analysis_zh: RoboTok 的主要工作是构建一个面向灵巧机器人操作的数据检索引擎，把互联网规模的人类手轨迹和参考视频提示结合起来，为策略学习提供更丰富、可扩展的示范来源。它解决的是灵巧操作领域高质量示教稀缺、人工标注成本高、单一演示覆盖不足的问题。方法上，系统利用手轨迹检索来筛选与任务相关的片段，再通过视频提示组织出可用于学习的参考信号，使数据获取从“少量人工采集”转向“规模化检索与筛选”。公开信息表明作者强调该引擎对灵巧操作学习的增益，但当前可见材料对具体模型结构、训练细节和下游任务设置披露有限。实验部分若以公开摘要为准，主要展示该检索式数据引擎的可行性与对灵巧策略学习的帮助，但缺少足够完整的跨基线数值和真实机器人对照。总体结论是它提供了一条很有潜力的数据扩展路径，限制在于公共信息还不足以判断其在不同手型、不同场景上的稳定收益。
items.analysis_en: RoboTok’s main contribution is a retrieval engine for dexterous robot manipulation that combines internet-scale human hand-trajectory retrieval with reference-video prompting to supply richer and more scalable demonstrations for policy learning. It tackles a core bottleneck in dexterous manipulation: scarce high-quality demonstrations, expensive manual annotation, and insufficient coverage from a handful of teleoperated examples. Methodologically, the system filters task-relevant segments through hand-trajectory retrieval and organizes them into learning signals via video prompting, shifting data acquisition from small-scale manual collection toward large-scale retrieval and selection. The public information suggests that the authors position this engine as a way to improve dexterous policy learning, but the available material is light on model architecture, training details, and downstream task specification. The experiments, at least from the public abstract-level information, appear to demonstrate feasibility and utility for dexterous policy learning, yet the release does not disclose enough cross-baseline numbers or real-robot comparisons. Overall, it offers a promising path for scaling data in dexterous manipulation, while the main limitation is that the public information is still insufficient to judge robustness across hand embodiments and scenarios.

caveats: 本轮按现有 seen-items 状态做增量去重。
检索范围覆盖 arXiv、会议与期刊网站、实验室与大学页面、公司研究博客、GitHub、项目页和 Hugging Face。
Aero Hand Open 的公开材料更偏平台发布与系统展示，定量实验信息有限。
RoboTok 的公开材料对模型细节和完整实验设置披露仍不充分，因此分析以公开摘要和项目级描述为主。
